items.title: Base change preserves the flat-at-primes-over condition for a module over an algebra
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the condition that a module be flat over the base at all primes containing the image of an ideal is preserved by base change, with the ideal extended correspondingly. The proof takes a prime of the base changed algebra containing the extended ideal, notes that the prime of the algebra below it contains the image of the ideal so that flatness holds there by hypothesis, observes that the localisation at the chosen prime is a localisation of the base change of that flat localised module, and derives flatness from stability of flatness under base change and localisation.
